summary: Link exact Submittal references, flag email self-references, and reject attachment provenance whose parent is not an email document.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and email content
Existing requirement that workflow relationships remain exact, read-only and non-inferential
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued RFI, Submittal and email accuracy improvements.
known_limitations: Only exact deterministic identifiers and persisted attachment provenance are used; semantic relationship inference remains unsupported.
Email self-reference detection covers locally parsed exact hashed header identifiers, not semantic quoted-text analysis.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no model, mailbox or external provider request is used.
